records.jp: むう……
records.en_original: Hmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmm...
records.en: Hmmm...

records.jp: 愛央、どうしたの？<CR>そっちには誰もいないみたいだけど
records.en_original: What's the matter, Ao? I don't think there's anyone there...
records.en_auxiliary: What's the matter, Ao? I don't think there's anyone there...
records.en: What's the matter, Ao?<CR>I don't think there's anyone there...

records.jp: え？　美弦さん、<CR>あの女の子が見えないの？
records.en_original: Huh? You mean you can't see that girl there, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You mean you can't see that girl there, Mio?
records.en: Huh?<CR>You mean you can't see that girl there, Mio-san?

records.jp: えっ！？<CR>だ、誰も見えない、けど……
records.en_original: What?! I-I don't see anyone...
records.en_auxiliary: What?! I-I don't see anyone...
records.en: What?!<CR>I-I don't see anyone...

records.jp: じゃあ、あの子はいったい……<CR>…………ああっ！
records.en_original: Then who am I seeing... Aaah!
records.en_auxiliary: Then who am I seeing... Aaah!
records.en: Then who am I seeing...<CR>Aaah!

records.jp: ひゃあっ！　ななな、なに！？
records.en_original: Hyaa! Wh-wh-what was that?!
records.en_auxiliary: Hyaa! Wh-wh-what was that?!
records.en: Hyaa! Wh-wh-what was that?!

records.jp: ──あははっ！　ひっかかった！<CR>冗談だよ、じょ・う・だ・ん！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Gotcha! It was a prank!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! Gotcha! It was a prank!
records.en: Ahaha! Gotcha!<CR>It was a prank!

records.jp: も、もう！<CR>驚かさないでよ……！
records.en_original: H-hey! Don't scare me like that!
records.en_auxiliary: H-hey! Don't scare me like that!
records.en: H-hey!<CR>Don't scare me like that!

records.jp: 廊下の長さについて考えてたんだあ。<CR>何メートルくらいあるんだろうって
records.en_original: I was just thinking about how long the hallway is. How many meters would you say?
records.en_auxiliary: I was just thinking about how long the hallway is. How many meters would you say?
records.en: I was thinking about the length of the hallway.<CR>I wondered how many meters it might be.

records.jp: そうね……端から端まで何歩かかるか数えれば、<CR>大体の長さはわかると思うけど……
records.en_original: Hmm... If you counted your steps, you could probably get a fairly good idea of its length.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... If you counted your steps, you could probably get a fairly good idea of its length.
records.en: Hmm... If you counted your steps,<CR>you could probably get a fairly good idea of its length.

records.jp: どうしても気になるなら、巻尺で測ってみる？
records.en_original: If you wanted to know its exact measurement, why not use a tape measurer?
records.en_auxiliary: If you wanted to know its exact measurement, why not use a tape measurer?
records.en: If you're that curious, why don't we measure it with a tape measure?

records.jp: いやいや、そこまでしなくても！<CR>ちょっと気になっただけだから
records.en_original: Oh, it's nothing that serious! I was just curious.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's nothing that serious! I was just curious.
records.en: Oh, it's nothing that serious!<CR>I was just curious.

records.jp: そう？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: まあ、いいわ。<CR>愛央ってときどき、突拍子もないことを考えるわね
records.en_original: You really come up with the most ridiculous ideas.
records.en_auxiliary: You really come up with the most ridiculous ideas.
records.en: Well, all right.<CR>Ao, you sometimes think of the most outlandish things.

records.jp: あはは、ごめんごめん
records.en_original: Haha, oops.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, oops.
records.en: Haha, oops.

records.jp: それにしても、この廊下……
records.en_original: But now that I think about it...
records.en_auxiliary: But now that I think about it...
records.en: But now that I think about it...

records.jp: 誰もいない廊下を見てると、<CR>無性に駆け抜けたくならない？
records.en_original: Don't you just want to run down empty big empty hallways like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you just want to run down empty big empty hallways like this?
records.en: When you look at a long, empty hallway,<CR>don't you suddenly want to sprint through it?

records.jp: もう、何言ってるの？<CR>廊下を走っちゃダメよ
records.en_original: Ao... You know it isn't proper to run in the halls.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao... You know it isn't proper to run in the halls.
records.en: Honestly, what are you saying?<CR>You're not supposed to run in the halls.

records.jp: わ、わかりました……
records.en_original: Yes, ma'am...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, ma'am...
records.en: Yes, ma'am...

records.jp: あら素直ね、いいことだわ
records.en_original: That's a good girl.
records.en_auxiliary: That's a good girl.
records.en: My, how honest. That's good.

records.jp: うう……美弦さんは、この長い廊下を見て<CR>ランナーの魂が疼かないわけ？
records.en_original: ...Do you really not feel something primal within you telling you to run down the hallway?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Do you really not feel something primal within you telling you to run down the hallway?
records.en: Ugh... Doesn't this long hallway make your runner's soul stir,<CR>Mio-san?

records.jp: ランナーの魂……？<CR>悪いけど、私のは疼かないみたいね
records.en_original: Primal? I'm sorry, it seems as though I don't.
records.en_auxiliary: Primal? I'm sorry, it seems as though I don't.
records.en: My runner's soul...?<CR>Sorry, but mine doesn't seem to stir.

records.jp: でも、何もない長い廊下って<CR>確かに見ていて気分が良いわ
records.en_original: Though I do admit, there is something nice about a big hallway like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I do admit, there is something nice about a big hallway like this.
records.en: Still, a long,<CR>empty hallway is certainly pleasant to look at.

records.jp: ゆっくり佇んで、物思いに耽っても、<CR>誰の邪魔にもならないものね
records.en_original: It's wide enough that I don't have to worry about bumping into anyone by accident.
records.en_auxiliary: It's wide enough that I don't have to worry about bumping into anyone by accident.
records.en: You can stand here quietly, lost in thought,<CR>without getting in anyone's way.

records.jp: つまり走っても、邪魔にはならない！
records.en_original: Exactly! Perfect for running down!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly! Perfect for running down!
records.en: Exactly! Perfect for running down!

records.jp: でも……この学校には私たちしかいないし、<CR>誰かにぶつかって怪我をすることもないんじゃないかな
records.en_original: But... We're the only ones here, so it's not like we'll run into anyone.
records.en_auxiliary: But... We're the only ones here, so it's not like we'll run into anyone.
records.en: But... We're the only ones here,<CR>so it's not like we'll run into anyone.

records.jp: …………それは一理ある、といえばあるのかしら？
records.en_original: I suppose that makes some sense...
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose that makes some sense...
records.en: I suppose that makes some sense...

records.jp: たとえばさ、世界に一人きりになったとして、<CR>それでも廊下を走るのはいけないこと？
records.en_original: Like, if you were the last person in the entire person, you still wouldn't do it?
records.en_auxiliary: Like, if you were the last person in the entire person, you still wouldn't do it?
records.en: For example, if you were the only person left in the world,<CR>would it still be wrong to run in the halls?

records.jp: また、極端な例を出したものね。でも……<CR>その仮定なら、確かにルールやマナーは無意味ね
records.en_original: That's quite the extreme example... I suppose that there would be no need for rules or manners in that case.
records.en_auxiliary: That's quite the extreme example... I suppose that there would be no need for rules or manners in that case.
records.en: That's quite the extreme example...<CR>I suppose that there would be no need for rules or manners in that case.

records.jp: でしょでしょ！
records.en_original: Yes, exactly!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, exactly!
records.en: Yes, exactly!

records.jp: 世界に一人きりとかストレスたまりそうだし、<CR>走ったほうが気晴らしになるよね！
records.en_original: Being the only person in the world's gotta be stressful as heck! Nothing better than some sprints to get rid of it!
records.en_auxiliary: Being the only person in the world's gotta be stressful as heck! Nothing better than some sprints to get rid of it!
records.en: Being the only person in the world sounds stressful,<CR>so running would be a good way to clear your head!

records.jp: まぁ……納得のいく話ではあるわね
records.en_original: Hmm... That's a convincing argument.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... That's a convincing argument.
records.en: Hmm... That's a convincing argument.

records.jp: うんうん！　やっぱ走りたいよね！
records.en_original: Uh-huh! I knew you'd agree with me!
records.en_auxiliary: Uh-huh! I knew you'd agree with me!
records.en: Uh-huh! I knew you'd agree with me!

records.jp: ちょっと待って。<CR>私はそこまで言ってな──
records.en_original: Now, wait a second. I didn't say that—
records.en_auxiliary: Now, wait a second. I didn't say that—
records.en: Now, wait a second.<CR>I didn't say that—

records.jp: 位置について……<CR>よーい、どん！
records.en_original: On your marks! Get set! GO!!
records.en_auxiliary: On your marks! Get set! GO!!
records.en: On your marks!<CR>Get set! GO!!

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと愛央！
records.en_original: W-wait! Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait! Ao!
records.en: W-wait! Ao!

records.jp: ほらほら美弦さん！<CR>早くしないと不戦敗だよー？
records.en_original: C'mon, Mio! You don't want to get disqualified, do you?
records.en_auxiliary: C'mon, Mio! You don't want to get disqualified, do you?
records.en: Come on, Mio-san!<CR>If you don't hurry, you'll lose by default!

records.jp: もう……
records.en_original: Jeez...
records.en_auxiliary: Jeez...
records.en: Jeez...

records.jp: あははっ！　美弦さん、はーやーくー！
records.en_original: Haha! Better hurry up!
records.en_auxiliary: Haha! Better hurry up!
records.en: Haha! Hurry up, Mio-san!

records.jp: こ、これはかけっこじゃなくて、<CR>愛央を捕まえるため、よ……っ
records.en_original: I-I'm not racing you! I'm only running to stop you!
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm not racing you! I'm only running to stop you!
records.en: Th-this isn't a race.<CR>I'm only running to catch you...!

records.jp: こら、待ちなさい！　愛央ーっ！
records.en_original: Stop right there! Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Stop right there! Ao!
records.en: Stop right there! Ao!

records.jp: 最初は美弦さんが鬼ね？<CR>鬼ごっこ、スタート！
records.en_original: Tag, you're it! Catch me if you can!
records.en_auxiliary: Tag, you're it! Catch me if you can!
records.en: You're it first, Mio-san!<CR>Tag starts now!

records.jp: わ、私が鬼！？
records.en_original: What do you mean, it?!
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean, it?!
records.en: What do you mean, it?!

records.jp: 美弦さーん！<CR>私のこと、早く捕まえてねー？
records.en_original: Mio! You're supposed to be catching me!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio! You're supposed to be catching me!
records.en: Mio-saaan!<CR>Hurry up and catch me, okay?

records.jp: ……はあ。<CR>仕方ないわね、付き合ってあげる
records.en_original: *Sigh* Fine, have it your way. I'll go along with your shenanigans.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* Fine, have it your way. I'll go along with your shenanigans.
records.en: ...Sigh.<CR>Fine. I'll play along.

records.jp: 待ちなさい！　愛央ーっ！
records.en_original: I'll get you!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll get you!
records.en: Wait! Ao!
